title: It Died.
text: It Died.. Well, it ALMOST lasted a year.  Thank goodness for Amazon's little tracking system that tells you when you bought an item.  I bought this on  May 24, 2014.  It died March 1, 2015.  It was quiet on the two lowest speeds, but loud on the High setting.  I was hoping that the fuse had burned out.  Called Vornado.  They sent a replacement.  It wasn't the fuse.  Thank goodness there's a 5 year warranty on this.  Hopefully I can get a new one for nothing.  I usually love Vornado.  Maybe this is the end of the affair.  I hope not ...  :(

product_metadata.title: Vornado 530 Compact Whole Room Air Circulator Fan, Black
features: POWERFUL VORTEX ACTION — Utilizes Vornado's signature Vortex air circulation to more effectively move air throughout the room.
SIMPLE CONTROLS — The 3-speed manual control is easy to use and allows you to dial in your comfort.
MULTI-DIRECTIONAL AIRFLOW — Equipped with an adjustable tilt head that allows you to direct the air where you need it.
OPTIMUM PERFORMANCE — Deep-pitched blades paired with an inlet guide cone, enclosed air duct, and spiral grill help move air up to 65 ft.

SUPERIOR SUPPORT — When you choose a Vornado fan, you’re investing in superior performance and design that will deliver total satisfaction. If not, we’ll replace it, for 5 years. Supported by a customer service team based in Andover, KS.
Built to meet U. S. voltage requirements. Certified, safety-tested, and warrantied for use only in the U. S.
description: The Vornado 530 Compact Whole Room Air Circulator continues Vornado's superior benchmark performance with a new edge definition design. With its unique signature grill and deep-pitched blade, the 530 moves air up to 65 feet while aerodynamically circulating all the air in a room. The 3-speed control allows for speed selection to meet any circulation need. The compact and convenient size makes the 530 perfect anywhere in the home or office. Use the 530 all year long for added comfort and energy savings in every season. Backed by Vornado's industry-leading 5-year warranty. Model is made for 120 volts only.

IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL DISCLAIMER: This item is built to meet U.S. voltage requirements and may not function properly when used in conjunction with external devices that alter or convert voltage or frequency of electricity. Improper use or shipping the product outside the U.S. will void all warranties.
